news.title: Cristiano Ronaldo announces retirement after 23 years with Portugal
news.lede: Cristiano Ronaldo has officially announced his retirement from international football, bringing an end to an extraordinary 23-year career with Portugal. The 41-year-old football legend confirmed the decision on Thursday, November 5, 2026, in an emotional video shared on social media. The announcement marks the end of an era for Portuguese football, with Ronaldo stepping away from the national team after becoming the most-capped player and highest goalscorer in men's international football history. However, Cristiano Ronaldo is not retiring from professional football entirely.
